tasks.label: Validate group pockets mobile
tasks.command: & C:\flutter\bin\flutter.bat analyze 2>&1 | Out-File -Encoding utf8 build\pockets-analyze.log; $a = $LASTEXITCODE; & C:\flutter\bin\flutter.bat test 2>&1 | Out-File -Encoding utf8 build\pockets-full-tests.log; $t = $LASTEXITCODE; @{analyze=$a; tests=$t} | ConvertTo-Json | Out-File -Encoding utf8 build\pockets-validation.json; Get-Content build\pockets-validation.json; Get-Content build\pockets-analyze.log; Get-Content build\pockets-full-tests.log -Tail 25
